ChatGPT — Release Notes

Updated 5 minutes ago

October 2, 2026

Sharing projects in ChatGPT Business

Workspace members on ChatGPT Business and Enterprise can now share a project with colleagues in the same workspace. Shared projects keep their files and instructions.

Learn more in our Projects guide.

Voice mode fixes

  • Fixed an issue where voice mode stopped after 30 seconds on some Android devices.

September 18, 2026

Scheduled tasks for Plus and Pro

Scheduled tasks are now available to Plus and Pro users on web. You can ask ChatGPT to run a prompt at a set time and get the result as a notification.
